HIPAA COMPLIANCE & PHI SAFEGUARDS

Healthcare Privacy Policy & HIPAA BAA

Effective Date: March 18, 2026 · Compliant with 45 CFR Parts 160 & 164 · Business Associate Terms

Patient Health Information Safeguards

AES-256 & TLS 1.3

End-to-end encryption for all resident census data in-flight and at-rest.

Immutable Audit Trail

Every PHI view, triage approval, or order modification is permanently logged.

Zero Data Resale

Zero commercialization, advertising data brokers, or public AI model training.

01.Scope & Covered Entities

This Healthcare Privacy Policy and Business Associate Agreement ("BAA") applies to all Protected Health Information ("PHI") and electronic Protected Health Information ("ePHI") processed by Shoreline Operations LLC ("Business Associate") on behalf of healthcare facilities, nursing homes, assisted living communities, and hospitals ("Covered Entity") using Shoreline Care OS.

All terms capitalized but not defined herein shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 ("HIPAA"), the Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health ("HITECH") Act, and their implementing regulations at 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164.

02.Permitted Uses & Disclosures of PHI

Shoreline processes PHI strictly and solely as necessary to fulfill clinical and dietary operations, including:

  • Ingesting admission, discharge, and transfer (ADT) records and therapeutic diet orders from PointClickCare or facility EHR systems.
  • Validating meal selections against physician orders, IDDSI 2.0 texture consistencies, and Big 9 food allergens.
  • Printing clinical tray cards, thermal kitchen tickets, and meal delivery sheets for food safety execution.
  • Compiling regulatory audit packs for CMS-2567 federal surveys and state health inspection binders.
Absolute Zero Data Resale Guarantee

We never sell, lease, license, or monetize resident health information. We do not use PHI to serve advertisements or train public AI models. Data processed through Shoreline is strictly isolated to your facility tenant.

03.Technical Safeguards & Architecture

Shoreline Care OS enforces strict technical and operational safeguards in compliance with 45 CFR § 164.312:

  • Private Cache Isolation: Resident endpoints (including /api/residents) bypass intermediary caching and explicitly emit Cache-Control: private, no-cache, must-revalidate headers scoped to tenant facility IDs, preventing cross-tenant leakage.
  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Five distinct permission tiers (Admin, Dietitian, Kitchen Manager, Line Cook, Front Desk). Line cooks access only prep sheets and tray cards; full clinical profile edits require verified Dietitian or Admin credentials.
  • Cryptographic Storage: All database volumes and automated backups are encrypted using AES-256-GCM. In-transit communication requires TLS 1.3 with modern cipher suites.
  • Argon2id Password Hashing: User authentication utilizes memory-hard Argon2id key derivation with high work factors to prevent credential stuffing attacks.
  • Automatic Inactivity Logout: Kiosks and workstations enforce automatic 10-minute idle session termination to prevent unauthorized terminal access.

04.Business Associate Obligations

In accordance with 45 CFR § 164.504(e), Shoreline agrees to:

  • Not use or further disclose PHI other than as permitted or required by this Agreement or as required by law.
  • Implement appropriate administrative, physical, and technical safeguards to prevent unauthorized use or disclosure of ePHI.
  • Report to Covered Entity any security incident or breach of unsecured PHI within seventy-two (72) hours of discovery.
  • Ensure that any subcontractors or cloud hosting providers who create, receive, maintain, or transmit PHI agree to the same restrictions.
  • Make available PHI for resident inspection, amendment, or accounting of disclosures upon written request.
  • Upon termination of service, return or cryptographically destroy all PHI maintained in any form, retaining zero unencrypted archival copies.

05.Executing a Facility BAA

Covered Entities subscribing to Shoreline Cloud SaaS can execute our standard HIPAA Business Associate Agreement directly through our automated onboarding portal or by requesting a counter-signed PDF copy from our compliance office.
